title: Reduce caffeine to your sleep-safe dose.
subtitle: Caffeine dose
rationale: Use the lower learned dose range when higher recorded doses cost more sleep or recovery than they return in performance.

evidence.summary: Caffeine's sleep effect increases with dose and proximity to sleep.

indications: Sleep or recovery degrades on higher-caffeine days.
Anxiety or jitteriness accompanies the current dose.
Late-day doses prop up energy that better sleep should supply.
